passage:
A doctor visited school to talk about sleep. Many students believed sleeping less was a sign of working hard.
The doctor showed how sleep affects memory, mood, reaction time, and health. She explained that the brain does important work while people sleep.
One student asked if drinking coffee could replace sleep. The doctor said coffee can hide tiredness for a while, but it does not repair the body.
After the talk, students tracked their sleep for one week. Many were surprised by how little they got.
They learned that rest is not wasted time. It is part of learning. A tired brain may sit at a desk, but it cannot work well.
